summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K providing notice of its upcoming Annual General and Special Meeting scheduled for July 30, 2026, with a record date of June 15, 2026. The filing confirms meeting logistics, securityholder voting classes (Common Stock and Restricted Common Stock), and proxy distribution details. No transaction, M&A, or special situation event is announced. The filing is a routine meeting notice and proxy circular for Canadian issuer, mapped to US equivalent of a proxy statement. No deal terms, financial details, or strategic changes are disclosed. This is not a special situation.
